brand.name: Otter Flow
brand.theme_strategy: Airy & Focused. Light mode is 'Pastel & Soft' (warm, optimistic, tactile). Dark mode is 'Swiss & High-Contrast' (deep obsidian, highly readable, distraction-free).

headings.import_instructions: Import using @fontsource/cabinet-grotesk or standard font linking.
headings.rules: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for sizes > 32px. Use fluid scaling up to text-5xl or text-6xl for massive impact.

body.import_instructions: Import using @fontsource/satoshi or use IBM Plex Sans/Geist as fallback.
body.rules: Clean, highly legible. Left-aligned by default.

mono_accents.rules: Use for overlines, metadata, and the empty placeholders for Sessions/Capsules. Must be uppercase with tracking-widest.

colors.rules: The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Never use pure black or pure gray. Always tint neutral greys (stone for light, neutral/obsidian for dark). Never use #1B93A4 (forbidden). No full-screen gradients. Texture > gloss.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers use p-8 or p-12. Inner cards use p-6.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid for Projects. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. gap-6. Every pixel utilized, but cards have breathing room internally.
layouts.project_detail: Massive H1 (text-5xl) overlapping standard layout. Clear separation between Project Meta (Name + Description) and the empty placeholder areas for Sessions & Capsules.
layouts.navigation: Minimalist top bar: Logo on left, User profile + Theme Toggle on right. Use solid background with bottom border (border-border), or heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60). NO entirely transparent headers.

cards.rules: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), NO shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color becomes more pronounced, and subtle shadow-lg added. Card contents left-aligned.

buttons.rules: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs. Sharp/slightly rounded (rounded-md) for secondary/ghost buttons. Explicit hover state with transition. NEVER rely on inheritance for text color on hover.

auth.rules: Use Clerk hosted components. MUST customize Clerk's 'appearance' prop to match the app's theme (variables: colorPrimary, colorBackground, colorText) so it doesn't look like generic Clerk.

forms.rules: Use Shadcn Input, Label, and Dialog. Do not use native HTML inputs directly. Inputs should have clear focus rings with high contrast (e.g., focus:ring-orange-500).

placeholders.rules: For Sessions and Capsules placeholders: Use dashed borders (border-dashed border-2 border-border/50), muted text, and a monospaced 'COMING SOON' or 'RESERVED' label to make it look like a technical schematic or blueprint.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions are mandatory. Hover states, press states (scale-95). Staggered entrance animations for the project list. Use CSS transitions: 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease'. NEVER use 'transition: all' (breaks transforms).

icons.rules: Use stroke-width 1.5. Clean, sophisticated. Do NOT use emojis as icons.

accessibility.rules: Ensure WCAG AA contrast. All interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='create-project-btn'). Explicit focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
